question: Why did one generated dashboard contain a visually discreet H45-like rail while later attempts collapsed into the same obvious fantasy roller/slide prototype?

realDeterministicControl.visualFact: preserves the two factual pieces while reorienting the factual group
realDeterministicControl.authority: actual research output, not producer-generated report imagery

criticalAuditFinding.observation: In the visually stronger aa89f137 dashboard, the panel labeled as the deterministic A control does not match the actual Mitchell deterministic output. The dashboard regenerated/synthesized its own A image as part of the infographic.
criticalAuditFinding.consequence: Similarity between dashboard A and dashboard B is internal self-consistency of a generated report, not evidence that B is source-grounded or faithful to the actual deterministic control.
criticalAuditFinding.positiveControlCorrection: aa89f137 remains useful only as a VISUALLY_DISCREET_GENERATIVE_REGIME_CONTROL, not as a factual-positive-control candidate until an image-only source-bound output exists.

observedRegimes.description: Generated rail is visually close to ordinary telescopic-slide hardware and could plausibly pass unnoticed at normal catalog scale.
observedRegimes.factualStatus: unverified / cannot be established from the self-generated dashboard comparison
observedRegimes.researchValue: shows that producer appearance quality can vary dramatically

observedRegimes.description: Repeated outputs converge on an obviously invented rail/roller mechanism with fantasy mechanical structures.
observedRegimes.researchValue: demonstrates stable prototype fallback rather than independent random detail errors

causalHypotheses.evidence: The visually discreet aa89f137 execution occurred immediately after the exact H45 source image was explicitly reintroduced as the active image target. Later repeatability attempts were issued after generated-dashboard context had accumulated and without re-establishing a fresh source target immediately before every run.
causalHypotheses.prediction: A clean context with explicit source-image binding should reduce or eliminate prototype fallback.

causalHypotheses.evidence: Every tested run returned a research dashboard/infographic despite the desired image-only product output. The producer is evidently conditioning strongly on the surrounding research-report conversation.
causalHypotheses.prediction: A minimal context containing only source + edit contract should materially increase image-only compliance.

causalHypotheses.evidence: When source adherence appears weak, several independent runs converge on essentially the same fantasy telescopic-slide/roller object instead of varying randomly.
causalHypotheses.prediction: A no-reference control would likely resemble the fantasy archetype more than the exact H45 source.

causalHypotheses.evidence: Both visually discreet and fantasy dashboards self-claim similar high-resolution masters, but no clean native output was obtained and those claims are non-authoritative.
causalHypotheses.prediction: Changing requested raster alone should not explain the regime switch.

causalHypotheses.evidence: Repeated convergence on the same fantasy prototype argues against purely independent seed noise as the main cause.
causalHypotheses.prediction: Under weak grounding, repeated runs should continue clustering around the archetype.

nextExperimentDesign.name: clean-context reference-binding A/B
nextExperimentDesign.reason: The current conversation is itself contaminated by repeated dashboards and cannot cleanly isolate reference binding.

inputs: actual deterministic Mitchell composition as non-factual layout reference
conditions.rule: the factual source remains identity authority; deterministic image supplies composition only
conditions.expectedIfH1H2True: same source landmarks with target composition, not a regenerated generic slide

conditions.expected: if H3 is correct, output should move toward the learned fantasy/generic slide archetype

requiredGate: cross-run clustering relative to source landmarks

currentConclusion: The apparent regression is best modeled as a regime switch between a discreet generic-hardware synthesis and an obvious fantasy-prototype fallback. There is still no verified source-grounded generative master. The strongest current causal suspects are reference-target binding and dashboard-context contamination.
